sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

9.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.
3.

The petitioners have filed this writ petition seeking to quash the notification issued under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ("2013 Act" in short) and to hold the entire land acquisition proceedings of L.A. Case No. 2/2017 as illegal.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ("2013 Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners contended that since the opposite parties have neither conducted public hearing at the affected area, nor recorded the views of the affected families in the Social Impact Assessment (SIA) report, therefore, without complying those mandatory requirements, publication of Notification under Section 11 of the 2013 Act is illegal, arbitrary and perverse in the eye of law.
Therefore, seeks for quashing of the same.

5. Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Additional Government Advocate contended that the contention which has been raised by the petitioners are contrary to the records available and as such there is true compliance of the provisions and the petitioners being participated in the proceeding, now at their instance, the present writ petition cannot be sustained and the same is liable to be dismissed.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and on going through the record, it appears that the sole grievance of the petitioners is that since the procedure envisaged under the 2013 Act has not been followed, therefore, the notification issued under Section 11 of the 2013 Act under Annexure-2 series should be quashed, but the same is absolutely contrary to the record.

On the basis of the Joginath Sahoo And Others vs State Of Odisha And Others ..... ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27944568/
1 documents available on record, it appears that the State SIA unit authorized M/s. Green India Jagatsinghpur to conduct SIA study vide his letter dated 11.01.2018.

entities.text: Joginath Sahoo And Others vs State Of Odisha And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per provision of Sub- section (1) of Section-8 of 2013 Act, the appropriate authority has issued Notification for carrying out SIA study in Form-C for commencement of consultation and SIA study vide notification dated 13.04.2018.
The substance of the Notification was served to the concerned village/G.P. for wide publication which requires under sub-section (2) of Section-8 of 2013 Act.
The SIA report prepared by Green India after opting all formalities under Section-9 to 13 of 2013 Act.

As per sub-section (6)
of Section-14, the District Administration organized a public hearing on 01.06.2018 in the Grama Panchayat Office, Badagunduri / Kotha Ghara, Badahira.

entities.text: Grama Panchayat Office, Badagunduri / Kotha Ghara
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The petitioners were also present in the said hearing.

To substantiate the presence of the petitioners, the State opposite parties have filed the documents Annexure-I/2 in which out of five petitioners, petitioner nos. 1, 3 and 4 participated in the proceeding.
Though the name of petitioner no.2 mentioned in the list, but he has put his signature.
7. In view of the above, the petitioners having participated in the meeting, now cannot turn around and pray for quashing of the notification issued under Section 11 of 2013 Act.
Thereby, this Court is not inclined to entertain this writ petition, which is accordingly dismissed.

(DR.
